package.name: drdds
package.description: Minimal copy of the S10 native drdds control messages used by s10_ros1_control. Definitions are byte-identical to the 48 robot's installed files (see SOURCE_SHA256.txt); MotionState follows the S10 developer guide p.48 and was accepted by the robot in the 2026-09-08 stand test. Built only inside the ros1_gateway workspace; it does not replace any other drdds installation.
